sentences.text: The offence under Section 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code is also alleged.
Therefore, notice to the victim is necessary in the light of Section 439(1A) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

2. The learned Public Prosecutor will instruct the Investigating Officer to give notice to the victim or the competent person, who is representing the victim, about the pendency of this bail application and the posting date and submit a report before this Court.
Registry shall issue a copy of this order to the learned Public Prosecutor, who will communicate this order to the Investigating Officer.
